snippet.title: Robert Pattinson becomes seventh actor to play James Bond | BBC News
snippet.description:
Robert Pattinson has been announced as the seventh person to play Bond in the official film series.
 
In a statement, the 40-year-old British actor says "to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime".
 
Speculation about Daniel Craig's replacement has been rife, with actors including Josh O'Connor, Callum Turner and Jack Lowden thought to have made it to the final screen tests.

Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight has been writing the script for the next film, with Dune's Denis Villeneuve to direct.
Thanking those who auditioned, Villeneuve says "we were surrounded by extraordinary talent", adding Pattinson "brings a spirit that is completely new".

snippet.description:
Never Doubt The Mind of Narendra Modi! #shorts 

Congress supporters and social media critics thought they had found another “Aloo Sona” moment when Narendra Modi spoke about farmers testing soil through mobile-based technology. Memes followed, with many questioning how a phone could possibly analyse soil.

But the technology Modi was referring to is not imaginary. It is called Bhu-Parikshak, a portable soil testing device developed by IIT Kanpur.

The handheld device uses Near-Infrared Spectroscopy to analyse a small soil sample and estimate important soil properties and nutrient levels. Based on the analysis, it can also provide fertiliser recommendations to help farmers make more informed decisions.

So, what exactly is Bhu-Parikshak? How does this technology work? And why did a statement about soil testing become another political meme battle?

In this video, we break down the science behind Modi Ji’s remark and the technology that many social media critics appeared to have missed.

snippet.title: じっくり焼くだけ！外ザク中とろ食感がたまらん激旨ポティト！#shorts
snippet.description:
こんにちはタカタクです♪
今回は以前作ったクロワッサンポティトで使った
菜麺器の使い方の質問いただいたので、アンサー動画を作りました！できたポティト麺で作ったポティトがザクザクで旨すぎた話。

ポティト揚げ続けてたら、本になりました🥔🍟
📕『史上最高に美味しい フライドポテトの作り方』
全国の書店・Amazon・楽天で発売中です📚
https://amzn.to/4wpObp4

▼ポテタクメンバーシップはこちら　
https://www.youtube.com/@takataku/join

動画で使った食材やキッチングッズ
▶︎ fanme.link/@takataku

〈材料〉
じゃがいも　400g（皮むいて）
（男しゃく）
お塩　　　　小さじ1/2
こめ油　　　大さじ2
バター　　　15g

《ソース材料》
トマトピューレ　100g
お水　　　　　　大さじ3
砂糖　　　　　　小さじ1/4
おろしにんにく　1/4片
お味噌　　　　　小さじ1/2
バター　　　　　10g
お塩　　　　　　少々

使用フライパン内径18cm

〈作り方〉
①じゃがいも皮をむき
　芽があればしっかり取り除く

②菜麺器にじゃがいもを差し込み
　トゲの部分で固定して
　ハンドルを回しながら細長くカットする
※中心に残ったきのこ型のじゃがいもも
　捨てずに揚げる
（菜麺器がない場合はスライサーなどで
　せん切りでも代用可）

③ボウルにポティト麺とお塩を入れて
　全体にお塩をなじませる

④油大さじ1をフライパンにひろげ
　ポティトを入れて厚さを均一に整えてから
　弱めの中火で着火

⑤ 3-4分焼いたらヘラでまわりを整えて
　6分くらい焼いたらフライパンゆすって
　焼きムラないようにポテポジを変える

⑥ じ〜っくり焼いて（動画は12分焼きました）
　ええ感じの焼き色ついてきたら
　ひっくり返して鍋肌から油大さじ1を投入
　
⑦ 裏面も7-8分焼いてこんがりキツネの
　ええ色になったらバターを加えて
　ポティトにバラーしみこんだらできあがり

⑧ソースは小鍋にトマトピューレ、お水
　砂糖、おろしにんにくをいれて一煮立ちさせ
　弱火で時々混ぜながら3〜4分グツグツ

⑨ お味噌をダマにならんように
　溶いてから加えたら火止めてバターを投入し
　お塩で整えたらソースの完成

このポティト外ザク中とろっ食感でめちゃくちゃ美味しいのでぜひ！

『美味しそうだなと思ったら高評価👍
　　　チャンネル登録よろしくお願いします😋』

〜ポテトのタカタク🥔〜
ポテトが大好物『タカタク』が作るポティトの世界！
たまにポティト以外のものも作ります。たまにね

snippet.title: Yastık altında şarj edilir mi?
snippet.description:
Dayı alarmı kulağının dibinde duymak için telefonu şarja takıp yastığın altına sokacakmış! 📱🛏️ 

Şarj olan telefon ısınır, yastık bu ısıyı içeride tutar. Telefon üreticileri ortam 35 °C'yi geçince pilin kalıcı olarak hasar gördüğünü yazıyor; ABD Ulusal Yangından Korunma Derneği de açıkça "cihazı yastığın altında, yatakta ya da kanepede şarj etmeyin" diyor. Sahte şarj aletleri işi daha da kötüleştiriyor: İngiltere'de yapılan bir testte 50 sahte ya da taklit şarj aletinin 49'u elektrik çarpması ya da yangın riski taşıyordu. Doğrusu: telefonu komodin gibi sert ve açık bir yüzeyde, orijinal ya da onaylı bir aletle şarj et. Pil şişer, aşırı ısınır, koku ya da renk değişimi olursa kullanma, servise götür.

Kaynaklar: NFPA (ABD Ulusal Yangından Korunma Derneği), Lithium-Ion Battery Safety · telefon üreticisinin pil ve güvenlik sayfaları (0–35 °C; "yastık, battaniye altına koymayın") · Electrical Safety First sahte şarj aleti testi (Electrical Review, 2019) · Newton (NH) İtfaiyesi uyarısı (2017).

Not: Görüntüler 3D canlandırmadır; dayı ve olaylar kurgudur.
